summary: Gemini 4 Argon promotional pricing ends: input $2.00→$4.00, output $10.00→$20.00, cached $0.10→$0.20 per 1M tokens.
Gemini 3.8 Flash paid tier: input $0.75→$1.50, output $3.75→$7.50, cached $0.075→$0.15 per 1M tokens. Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS doubles the same day ($0.50→$1.00 in, $9.00→$18.00 out).
GPT-5.6 Sol promotional pricing guaranteed "at least through November 21, 2026" ($4.00 in / $20.00 out).
Billing for gpt-rosalind-research began ($5.00 in / $25.00 out per 1M tokens).
"Priority processing" renamed "Fast mode" (2x standard token price).
gpt-image-2 standard was incorrectly set to batch rates; corrected to $8/$30/$2 (batch $4/$15).
Haiku 5.5 long-context tier (>100K) now applied in finder/calculator via long_context field.
Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview long-context tier (>200K) now applied via long_context field.
Filled Mistral Large 4 first-party row from 2026-10-29 launch post: $0.70/$2.10 ($0.07 cached).
Gemini 3.6 Flash paid tier: input $0.75→$1.50, output $3.75→$7.50, cached $0.075→$0.15 per 1M tokens (batch $0.375→$0.75 / $1.875→$3.75).
Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS paid tier: input $0.50→$1.00 (text), output $6.00→$12.00 (audio) per 1M tokens. Row added to the dataset.
Gemini Robotics ER 2 Preview and ER 2 Streaming Preview: input $1.00→$2.00, output $5.00→$10.00 per 1M tokens (ER 2 cached $0.10→$0.20). Rows added to the dataset.

Search and Fetch APIs start per-request billing at 00:00 Beijing time (2026-10-31 16:00 UTC): $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests each. Server-side tool calls via DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code and Codex were free until then.
Google Cloud Agent Platform: Gemini 4 (incl. Argon) completions over 32K tokens are charged for retrievable token usage even if the request fails on a client or server timeout.
Gemini 3.7 Flash (Google Cloud Agent Platform, global): input $0.75→$1.50, output $3.75→$7.50, cached $0.075→$0.15 per 1M tokens. Row added to Ratecard.

grok-4.7 long-context tier added: above 200K prompt tokens $4.00 in / $12.00 out (cached $1.00); standard cached $0.50; Batch API 20% off. Finder/calculator now price long prompts at the higher tier (OpenRouter Grok 4.7 row too).
